messages.subject: R/qtl2 version 0.38
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl2 (version 0.38) has been released on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available within a few days.

A few minor changes and a bug fix:

  - There is a potential speed-up of multi-core calculations in
    scan1() with a polygenic effect.

  - We added a function compare_founder_geno() which is like
    compare_geno(), but comparing the founder genotypes.

  - We fixed a bug in read_cross2() that caused a crash with multi-way
    RIL when the cross info was misspecified

Karl Broman

messages.subject: Allelic series number estimation
messages.body_plain:
Hey there,
In a multiparent population I´ve been estimating the peak marker allele effects with fit1 and blup=T. One gets the effect estimates and SE for each of the parental allele. Visually it seems that in some QTLs there are two alleles, in some 3 or 4. Anyone would have a suggestion of an analysis for estimating the number of alleles. Doing pairwise combinations?
